svg.title: Auditing agent-generated biomedical code with executable contracts
svg.desc: A four-stage workflow with one outcome under each stage. An LLM agent writes an A2A receptor virtual screen of natural-product libraries, which released 3 of 497 docked compounds; ten executable contracts over nine gates detected 124 of 128 seeded faults, where deterministic snapshots detected all 128; 1 of 5 blind-authored faults was detected and equivalent SMILES changed all 25 docking scores; and the released run kept 72 of 5,000 compounds as eligible, against a median of 1,004 over 200 reorderings of the training rows.
svg.text: Auditing agent-generated biomedical code with executable contracts
Contract coverage, decision stability and biomedical validation must be evaluated separately.
